# ymfm (vendored subset)

The YM2151 (OPM) part of [ymfm](https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm) by Aaron Giles, BSD 3-Clause (see `LICENSE`), as used by x16-emulator: `ymfm.h`, `ymfm_fm.h`, `ymfm_fm.ipp`, `ymfm_opm.h`, `ymfm_opm.cpp`, unmodified, from commit 81aec25ccb (2026-07-27). Used by `src/plugins/devices/ym2151/`.
